en.name: MileMaster
en.short_description: GPS mileage tracker with IRS-compliant deduction reports for gig workers

_blocked.no_copy_drafted: No listing copy can be written. Trips are hard-coded.
_blocked.evidence: lib/main.dart:121-125 _recentTrips is a literal list ('Office HQ' -> 'Client Site A', 12.4 mi, 'Today, 9:15 AM'). The dashboard total, the tax-deduction figure (_totalMiles * 0.67) and the weekly chart are all computed from it. Geolocator is called once for a current position (main.dart:144-149) and no trip is ever recorded from it. The `pdf` dependency is declared but nothing in main.dart references it, so there is no export.
_blocked.to_unblock: Implement trip recording and persistence before writing a mileage-tracker listing. Shipping this as an IRS-deduction tool on top of four invented trips is the worst risk in the portfolio.
